title: lachnagrostis eriantha
intro: Lachnagrostis eriantha, commonly known as Australian blue grass or blue oat grass, is a type of flowering plant native to Australia and New Zealand. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Lachnagrostis eriantha include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
